text:
My director changed Sora's STANDING LIGHT. Your thrust sheet (attached, image 2) has too much wind-up for a light attack and too much range. Instead, it is a quick GUARD BASH, like bunting with a baseball bat: Sora holds the Kingdom Key level across his body - right hand on the handle, left hand steadying it further along the shaft - and pushes it a short way forward so the Keyblade's GUARD (the gold hand guard) hits the opponent on the right. Fast, almost no wind-up, short reach, hands stay close to his chest.




Attached: (1) Sora's approved battle idle in our sprite style (start and end pose), (2) your earlier thrust sheet - do NOT repeat its big draw-back or long lunge.




My director's rules: the knees must always bend the natural way; keep the Keyblade close to his body.




Please generate an image: a clean concept sheet of this Standing Light, facing screen right, plain white background, the same 2D cel style, KH2 outfit and Kingdom Key as the attached sprite, the same character size in every pose, no text, labels or effects. 5 poses in order:

1. Battle idle (as in image 1).

2. Set: the Keyblade turned level across his chest like a bunt, left hand sliding up to hold the shaft, right hand on the handle, guard toward the opponent, a small step in.

3. Bash: both arms push the level Keyblade a short way forward so the guard strikes, body leaning in a little, front knee bent.

4. Recoil: the Keyblade pulled back to his chest, still level.

5. Back to the battle idle (as in image 1).
